# Settling INV-USD-001 with the split whose CAD value is −139.37.
#
# The link itself is the ordinary one: the invoice is USD, the split holds
# 100.00 USD, and the settlement is what the split already says. The rate with
# cents matters only on the way back out — unlinking onto a CAD account writes
# the split's value, and −139.37 is a figure an account kept to whole dollars
# cannot state.
#
# What this fixture produces: the split on `Assets:Accounts Receivable USD` at
# −100.00 USD, valued −139.37 CAD, in the invoice's lot.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_unlinking_a_linked_transaction.py.
invoice "INV-USD-001"
  customer_id: "C-US"
  currency: USD
  date_opened: 2026-01-05
  entry:
    date: 2026-01-05
    description: "Consulting"
    action: "Hours"
    account: "Income:Sales"
    quantity: 1
    price: 100
    taxable: false
    tax_included: false
  posted:
    date: 2026-01-05
    due: 2026-02-05
    ar_account: "Assets:Accounts Receivable USD"
    memo: "Invoice INV-USD-001"
    accumulate: true
  payment:
    date: 2026-03-04
    amount: 100
    account: "Assets:Bank"
    txn_guid: "aabbccddeeff00112233445566778899"
    txn_split_guid: "ccddeeff00112233445566778899aabb"
